corporate_actions_applied.source: SMITH-LEDGER 2026-08-26 dust cleanup -- runs/2026-08-26-1315/holdings.json shows SNDK fully absent (0 of 37 rows), while lots.json carried a 1e-06sh residue dated 2026-08-07 @ $1212.38. compute_book.json flagged this exactly (prior_qty 1e-06 -> current_qty 0.0, ratio 0.0). No confirmation email exists or could exist for a fill this small -- this is floating-point summation noise, not an unrecorded trade.
corporate_actions_applied.notes: Sourced adjustment row per smith_ledger.py's own orphan-dust guidance (severity='dust' case): clear sub-epsilon residue with an explicit, sourced adjustment row rather than silently dropping it or fabricating a sell confirmation. Zeroes the SNDK lot exactly (qty_change -1e-06 against a 1e-06 lot). CORRECTED same-run: initial qty_change of exactly -1e-06 was a silent no-op -- smith_ledger.py's _consume_fifo guards on `remaining > SHARE_EPS` (SHARE_EPS=1e-6), so a consume amount exactly AT epsilon never entered the loop and the lot was untouched (engine logged it as 'applied' regardless -- the log reflects the row was processed, not that it took effect). Changed to -2e-06 (double the true ~1.0e-06 residual) so the FIFO consumption loop actually executes; the resulting ~1e-06 shortfall stays below SHARE_EPS and is correctly not reported as a phantom short.
